artifact: Osler-JEPA whole-body trajectory and uncertainty contract
goal: Represent a complete target-by-horizon factual physiology trajectory while moving only validated cells and withholding numeric confidence intervals until calibration passes.

fallback_cells.fast_targets_at_unvalidated_horizons: persistence until a target-horizon held-out gate passes
fallback_cells.slow_renal_targets_at_short_horizons: persistence because the physiology is too slow for the horizon

uncertainty_policy.missing_calibration_policy: do not show numeric intervals; set interval_status to needs_calibration_audit

output_schema.lower: numeric lower interval bound or null
output_schema.upper: numeric upper interval bound or null
output_schema.source: validated router, belief state, multihop path, persistence, or missing
output_schema.can_move: true only when the target-horizon cell is validated
